timeline.title: The Beginning of a Legacy
timeline.text: The Hyderabad Chamber of Commerce was established to represent the business and trading community across the erstwhile Hyderabad State

timeline.title: A Federation Is Established
timeline.text: The formation of Andhra Pradesh marked a major administrative change, paving the way for the Chamber's broader regional role.

timeline.title: A Federation Is Established
timeline.text: The organisation became the Federation of Andhra Pradesh Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FAPCCI), expanding its representation across the state.

timeline.title: Industry Connections
timeline.text: FTAPCCI continued bringing together industry representatives and business leaders.

timeline.title: Government Engagement
timeline.text: FTAPCCI hosted interactions with national leaders, supporting dialogue on business and economic matters.

timeline.title: Engaging with National Leaders
timeline.text: FTAPCCI welcomed distinguished leaders and facilitated interactions with the industry community.

timeline.title: Industry–Government Dialogue
timeline.text: FTAPCCI continued representing business interests through discussions with government and industry stakeholders.

timeline.title: Promoting Industry Growth
timeline.text: FTAPCCI continued its work connecting businesses, policymakers and industry representatives.

timeline.title: A New Chapter for Telangana
timeline.text: The formation of Telangana marked a new phase in the Federation's regional representation.

timeline.title: A New Identity
timeline.text: On 14 January 2015, the Federation became the Federation of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FTAPCCI).

timeline.title: Celebrating a Century
timeline.text: FTCCI marked 100 years of supporting trade and industry, with its centenary celebration held in December 2016.

timeline.title: Expanding Industry Representation
timeline.text: FTCCI continued its role in representing businesses and connecting industry with government and policymakers.

timeline.title: A New Identity for Telangana
timeline.text: On 2 April 2019, the Federation adopted the name Federation of Telangana Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FTCCI), strengthening its focus on Telangana’s economic development.

timeline.title: Supporting Business Through Uncertainty
timeline.text: FTCCI continued sharing government notifications and compliance updates to help businesses navigate the COVID-19 period.

timeline.title: Strengthening Industry Support
timeline.text: FTCCI continued providing industry updates, policy information and business resources during the economic recovery.

timeline.title: Driving MSME Development
timeline.text: FTCCI collaborated with MSME authorities on awareness programmes supporting cluster development and the competitiveness of micro and small enterprises.

timeline.title: Showcasing Industrial Innovation
timeline.text: FTCCI organised the Industrial Innovation & Technology Expo (IITEX 2023), bringing together industry, technology and business opportunities.

timeline.title: Building Skills for Global Trade
timeline.text: FTCCI expanded export-import training initiatives, helping entrepreneurs and businesses strengthen their international trade capabilities.

timeline.title: Advancing Industrial Innovation
timeline.text: FTCCI hosted the second edition of IITEX, connecting manufacturers, innovators and industry leaders through exhibitions and business networking.

timeline.title: Recognising Excellence and Enabling Growth
timeline.text: FTCCI continued supporting Telangana’s industry through its Excellence Awards, MSME initiatives and programmes focused on sustainable industrial growth.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: Be the voice of Industry, Commerce and Trade, foster healthy & pro-business environment, aim on issue advocacy while nurturing sustainable industrial development.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To be the vibrant apex federation and voice of business, shaping policy, strengthening business–government coordination, and driving economic growth in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

faqs.q: Do I need to carry Physical Card to avail benefit?
faqs.a: You can carry either the physical card or the e-card, along with your Aadhaar card, to avail the benefit from the service provider.

faqs.q: I want to avail service now; do I get the card instantly?
faqs.a: You have to register your details under your company's registration link on the FTCCI Privilege Card portal.

faqs.q: I am registering online. Can I pay in cash to anyone?
faqs.a: Your organisation's team will coordinate with you to complete your registration and the payment.

faqs.q: I am registering offline. Can I make payment online?
faqs.a: Your organisation's team will coordinate with you to complete your registration and the payment.
Every family member can avail the benefit after individual registration and an individual payment of Rs. 200/-.

faqs.q: Do all Family Members need to register personally?
faqs.a: Family members can be registered by the employee of the registered member organisation covered under this offer.

faqs.q: Can kids use the card of their parents?
faqs.a: No. Every individual is issued a separate card with a unique ID.

faqs.q: Kids/Parents do not have Mobile Number/Email
faqs.a: The card is issued under the guardian member's mobile number, with the child's or parent's Aadhaar details registered.

faqs.q: Will registration charges be less if I register at later date?
faqs.a: No. The registration charges stay the same whenever you register for the FTCCI Privilege Card.
